rules.instruction: Use lowercase mushenzhen and slogan a city for makers. The Mu is the parent community; Garage, Frontier Fusion and Human Flourishing are the three paths.

Commercial use is allowed; credit must mention mushenzhen. Suggested wording: 视觉素材来源：mushenzhen. No standard public license has been selected. This does not cover third-party fonts, photos or tool code.
Use assets/logos/full canonical variants; one letter or composite symbol per square cell, 3 rows, cell size 50 source units. Scale the entire approved composition uniformly; do not reflow it.
Supply black, white and core-green variants.
Partner colors and compositions may vary while retaining recognizable brand visual language. This does not automatically authorize arbitrary recoloring of formal logos.
Use supplied SVG geometry, scale uniformly, do not retype the wordmark, distort, add effects or rearrange internal parts.
Full logos: H is the three-row construction height (3 cells). Simple logos: H is visible artwork height. Reserve clear space on all sides;
Conservative starting points from raster screen-size study; verify final output. No print minimum established.
Balance visible weight and align optically. Gap must accommodate both clear spaces. Do not impose mushenzhen dominance for equal partnerships.
Prefer black on light, white on dark, green on brand ink. Avoid green on white and busy image interference. This is not an accessibility certification.
Use consistent cell scale, deliberate runs and pauses, an independent element layer and clear negative-space structure. Do not stretch slash widths independently.
